blocks.title: Observe
blocks.text: Pipelining overlaps separate stages of different tasks; it increases throughput after filling the pipeline, not necessarily single-task latency.

blocks.title: Explain
blocks.text: Four tasks on a three-stage pipeline complete in six ideal cycles, versus twelve when each task runs all stages in isolation.

blocks.title: Evaluate
blocks.text: Choose the computational method that fits: decomposition for parts; backtracking for reversible choices; heuristic for guided estimates; visualisation for patterns.
